data.title: 椎名真由理 · 神社参道长阶的星尘握手
data.description: 秋叶原古老神社高耸的石阶之巅，满天璀璨银河倒垂。真由理身着浅空蓝吊带裙仰起脸庞，向着夜空星辰伸出双手，眼神纯净而充满对未来的眷恋。
data.location: high shrine stone staircase landing looking out over starry galaxy night sky
data.action: standing with arms raised high reaching toward celestial stars, head tilted up with wondrous innocent smile, sundress hem fluttering
data.lighting: 璀璨银河星光与石灯笼暖黄烛光
data.promptProse: Mayuri reaches both hands high toward the brilliant Milky Way on a quiet shrine overlook, her face illuminated by starry celestial light.
data.animaCaption: Starlight sparkles in her wide innocent eyes as she reaches upward into the night sky. The shrine lantern lights her face and the stone steps under the stars.
